status: Read-only post-release diagnosis; original decision and scores unchanged.

method.verified: All 37 nonfull question canonical catalogs recomputed by frozen helper and matched isolated receipt catalog hashes. Context-object hashes matched isolated receipts. Every owner original 5900/2900-character XML exactly replayed with frozen runtime. SQLite opened mode=ro and query_only; Store constructor bypassed. 60000-character replay changes only render allowance, not query or stored state. No model calls, regrading, or original data edits.
method.span_policy: Displayed prefix end=start+visible quote length; union coverage only joins same original source field within one isolated question. Full source visibility is support availability, not a claim the answer recalled all clauses.

query_selector_hypothesis.result: Not supported as the causal explanation for this set. All diagnosed cross-project q6 plans have empty hard identifier lists; selected authorized owners remain separate. No required source is lost to an environment selector.
query_selector_hypothesis.exception: hold_710/q6 parses production as an environment, although production steps is a workflow phrase. Its required sources survive and the unrecalled fact is fully visible, so no causal environment loss is established.
query_selector_hypothesis.not_claimed: This does not prove environment parsing correct for all future questions.

root_causes.cause: Rendered source units are sentence/field fragments competing with repeated provenance; smaller tool field can be reserved instead of full captured check. Required positive/negative clauses or source scope disappear even though same-query records contain them.
root_causes.evidence: 15 missing fact spans become complete at 60000 characters with unchanged selection; seven q5 tool facts lose a complementary sentence. Cross-project per-owner budget is 2900 rather than 5900.

root_causes.cause: Question intent is still partly matched as source vocabulary; original is a historical trigger and generic structural facets can remain mandatory topics. Some captured raw-role records also fail exact-token candidate search.

Raw fallback accepts only known execution-tool shapes. The fixture uses fictional_offline_capture, so it has no native execution fallback; if extraction omitted a source, capture alone cannot recover it through that lane. Do not repair this by adding the fixture tool name to a production allowlist.
Reader omits available clauses or creates unsupported temporal/causal relations; source availability alone does not repair this.
root_causes.evidence: 14 unrecalled facts fully visible; five of eight paired fact losses fully visible in both variants. Two primary critical edges absent from original text.

one_general_repair_recommendation.proposal: Review budget allocation around complete original source/field units before selecting inferred episode field labels: complementary result/limitation sentences from the same bounded captured source should compete as one source unit, with repeated pointers deduplicated and source-specific identity/order retained. Preserve all existing project/session/privacy/deletion/hard constraints.
one_general_repair_recommendation.why_proven: Same-query large-budget replay recovers 15 missing full spans, including three paired-loss facts, without any selection or generation change. Existing minimum-size observed-field reservation demonstrably chooses only one sentence.
one_general_repair_recommendation.limits: This is a prospective general design direction, not authorization to tune R10 or claim a score improvement. It cannot fix the 14 fully visible reader omissions, lexical preselection failures, or unsupported reader-created edges.
